gate.rationale: The owner command of 2026-10-26 explicitly directed completion of D2/D3/D4, Tool Adapter/acceptance and policy-version blockers, not merely documenting them. This follow-on gate supersedes the registration exclusion of the earlier MAEP-022 implementation record for this bounded factory candidate only. superiority_basis.correctness: A production-factory HTTP E2E calls create_service with the real registered builders, performs task creation through authority, dispatches fs.write, independently reads back file content, and reaches CLOSED_VERIFIED only after the mandatory read-back gate passes (EV-REG-FACTORY-E2E).
superiority_basis.security: D2 verifies owner policy approval, D3 checks the owner-issued token and revocation file, D4 checks approved Memory/write provenance, and fs.write binds request digest, action, resource, scope and rooted path; isolated E2E tests use no patched production binding registry.
superiority_basis.reliability: Termux Python 3.14.6 runtime suite and subsystem suites pass; UNKNOWN remains blocking until reconciliation, and restore/rebind never automatically restores authorization. Existing negative tests cover malformed/missing evidence and denied scope.
superiority_basis.functional_coverage: The registered production subset is runtime.service composition with fs.write and read-back acceptance. This gate does not claim other tools (fs.read, code.*, test.run, url.read) are registered or implemented.
superiority_basis.compatibility: Schema-v2 is for runtime.service only. Existing hg serve config is schema-v1 and stays on release f7cfd766… from main f3dac34; no production configuration migration, session issuance, data migration or deployment occurred.
superiority_basis.performance_resource_cost: No production service benchmark is claimed. The full runtime unittest suite took 181.576 seconds on Termux; this is test-suite wall time, not request latency. The adapter/receipt path remains single-owner volume.
superiority_basis.maintainability_operational_burden: All builders are code-owned and use the existing Python standard-library runtime modules. Owner config names paths only; factory still validates the trust root, active policy, Memory DB, session and revocations before service composition.
